brand.name: Smart Civic Complaint Triage System
brand.tagline: Cleaner Streets · Safer Communities · A Smarter City
brand.heroDesc: Report street infrastructure issues in seconds. Our AI-assisted triage system clusters duplicates, assesses public safety risk, and dispatches municipal crews quickly.

howItWorks.title: How CivicCare Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From citizen reporting to municipal closure in 4 transparent stages
howItWorks.step1Desc: Upload a photo and pin location. Describe in English, Urdu, or Roman Urdu.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Multi-modal AI classifies category, detects 50m duplicates, and scores severity.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Assigned department crew resolves problem with verifiable GPS timestamps.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Admin inspects before-and-after photo evidence before final closure.
